objectives.text: Find the card with two orange diamonds that a tall red house that is next to a rock is next to.
Find the card with one black heart that a short blue house that is 3 tiles from a short grey house is next to.
Find the card with two black hearts that a short yellow house that is beside a rock is next to.
Find the card with two green hearts that a short grey house that is beside a tree is beside.
Find the card with two orange stars that a short blue house that is 2 tiles from a short red house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two green diamonds that a short blue house that is next to a short grey house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two blue circles that a rock that is next to a short green house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one green plus that a lamppost that is 2 tiles from a short blue house is next to.
Find the card with one orange heart that a tall red house that is next to a rock is 3 tiles from.
Find the card with one orange star that a tall red house that is next to a rock is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one red star that a short yellow house that is next to a short green house is next to.
Find the card with one red circle that a short red house that is beside a tall red house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one orange circle that a short grey house that is next to a short blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one black circle that a short green house that is next to a tall red house is 3 tiles from.
Find the card with two red hearts that a short grey house that is 2 tiles from another short grey house is 2 tiles from.
